verdict.rationale: Docs show extensive API coverage (card creation, authorization rules, balance management, card lifecycle, disputes) mirroring Customer Area capabilities, and Adyen exposes APIs as the primary interface. However, some features like uploading dispute zip files and viewing card payments are explicitly Customer Area-only (pilot feature), and no discoverable OpenAPI spec was found via probes, undercutting full API-parity claims. missing for 10: evidence of API equivalents for Customer-Area-only dispute upload and payment viewing features, a public OpenAPI/machine-readable spec confirming full API surface, independent confirmation of full UI-API parity.
